doc.title: Ray Drummond interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003

title: Ray Bryant tribute record and the Golden Fingers concerts
summary: They discuss his recording on Ray Bryant's piano-friends tribute and Bryant, Junior Mance, Renee Rosnes and Kenny Barron at the Japanese concerts.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: I see. You play on one of my recent favorite CDs and that’s with Ray Bryant, a tribute to his piano friends.

See now that reminds me I need to talk to Ray. I haven’t talked to him in probably a year. I mean we haven’t worked together in even longer but I really need to call him up and talk to him. Because I mean there’s another precious resource, folks. And he’s still here. And the people who get to hear him the most are the Japanese because they bring him over for the Golden Fingers concerts every two years.
Right, with Junior Mance and those fellas.
Junior Mance and this year Renee’s going again she’s going and of course Kenny Barron, who is here.
He is here. He’s here at the — I haven’t seen him but they tell me he’s camped out here wandering around so I’ve got to go hang out with my old drinking buddy.
Well I’ll be looking for him actually.
Yeah he’s here. He’s not doing anything, he’s not a clinician and he’s not a performer.
